name: Cultist: Void-Touched marks direct heals on allies and self; Gaze of C'Thun consumes them (#11428)
contract: Void-Touched 300286 is the Cultist's level 30 passive: 'Direct healing done now applies Void-Touched' 301982,
which stacks 10 times. Casting Gaze of C'Thun 500110 consumes the stacks on every ally carrying the Cultist's
Void-Touched and heals them with Void-Touched 301983, itself a direct heal that applies one new stack. The pop
happens before the Gaze lands, so the Gaze heal 520333, also a direct heal, adds one more stack to its target
instead of being consumed by the same cast. A direct heal marks its target even when it only overheals, so an
ally at full health is marked too. A self-heal marks the Cultist once: the stack follows the heal that landed,
not the separate healer and target proc events a self-heal raises.

steps.label: Let login settle
CONTROL: the Void-Touched passive is active on the Cultist
CONTROL: the ally carries no Void-Touched before any healing
CONTROL: the ally is at full health
Gaze of C'Thun overheals the ally at full health
CONTROL: the Gaze of C'Thun heal landed on the ally
The Gaze overheal marks the full-health ally with one stack the same cast keeps
CONTROL: no Void-Touched consumption heal before the next Gaze
Let the global cooldown end
The next Gaze of C'Thun consumes the mark
Gaze of C'Thun heals the marked ally with Void-Touched
The Void-Touched pop heal and the new Gaze heal each leave one stack
Clear any chained mark on the Cultist
CONTROL: the Cultist carries no Void-Touched before healing himself
Let the global cooldown end
Gaze of C'Thun heals the injured Cultist himself
CONTROL: the Gaze of C'Thun heal landed on the Cultist
The direct self-heal marks the Cultist with one Void-Touched stack
Let the global cooldown end
The next Gaze of C'Thun consumes the Cultist's own mark
Gaze of C'Thun heals the marked Cultist with Void-Touched
